Muted gochujang red, walnut brown, cream and warm plaster.

Keep the jar and saucer naturally grouped toward the lower-center, with ample quiet negative space above and on the right. Sparse, poised, editorial composition with depth and breathing room. No extra props beyond the onggi jar and lid, metal spoon, ivory saucer and modest natural linen.

No packaging, labels, writing, logos, people, hands, flames, decorative ingredient scatter, floating ingredients, watermark, Japanese props, artificial glow, excessive saturation or wet plastic surfaces. No crops through essential objects.
